Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
FIX: Switch from f16 to u16 packed histogram (fixed-point)

Root cause identified: pack2x16float creates IEEE 754 float bit
patterns, but atomicAdd performs INTEGER addition, corrupting the
float representation.

Solution: Use u16 fixed-point integers instead of f16 floats.

Changes:
- Convert colors to u16 (0-65535 range) before packing
- Pack using bit shifts: r16 | (g16 << 16u)
- Unpack using bit masks: (packed >> 16u) & 0xFFFFu
- Integer addition works correctly on fixed-point values

Trade-off Warning:
- Scale=65535: High precision but overflows after ~1 hit at max brightness
- This WILL cause artifacts in bright areas
- May need to reduce scale to 1000 or 100 for practical use

Documentation:
- Created U16_PACKED_HISTOGRAM.md explaining the approach
- Documents precision vs overflow tradeoff
- Notes that naive atomics may still be best for quality

Next: Test with fractals to see if overflow is acceptable

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
